corpus: the unique passages of the pinned ViBidLQA train, val and test sources, unique after NFC, case folding and whitespace collapse; a passage's id is the SHA-256 of its normalized text, the corpus is in id order, and a passage's text is its first raw form in the order train, val, test
query_note: the question exactly as the item asks it; no passage, gold answer, label or arm outcome
tokens: maximal runs of Unicode word characters (Vietnamese syllables and numbers)

bm25.query_terms: each distinct query token counts once

fixed_on: 2026-10-27, after the exploratory K2.1 bake-off on the 1,928 ViBidLQA train questions (this BM25: own passage at rank 1 for 64.7%, in the top 2 for 78.1%); the project owner chose it over BGE-M3, a BM25 + BGE-M3 hybrid and a reranker
